title: Cardinal Sega's legation, Paris 1593: BnF fr. 3984 nos. 6 and 8

plaintext.source: Tomokiyo, Cryptologia 43(1) 2019: preliminary decipherment (not read here)

transcription.notes: c. 14,500 figures (Brice Dudout); not transcribed here

system.summary: Two different ciphers: no. 8 a homophonic substitution with a small nomenclator (Z word separator; D, N, X nulls); no. 6 continuous figures, letters as figure pairs, 3 and 8 nulls, nomenclator numbers framed by nulls (Brice Dudout, unverified here).

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo, Cryptologia 43(1) 2019, 23-46 (preliminary decipherment of 1593 continuous-figure texts, probably no. 6); Brice Dudout's partial candidate readings (bdudout.github.io/europe-chiffree/en/sega-1593.html, Oct 2026)

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Split from the Desportes letters (catalogue 20); recorded Brice Dudout's partial readings and Tomokiyo 2019 as the comparison still to make.

outcome.method_basis: Not yet attempted here; outside partial readings wait on a comparison with Tomokiyo 2019.
outcome.notes: Status: in progress. Split 20 Oct 2026 from the old targets/sega1593 (now targets/desportes1593).

credits.note: partial candidate readings of nos. 6 and 8, reported 19-20 Oct 2026; not yet checked
Cryptologia 43(1) 2019: segmentation and preliminary decipherment of 1593 continuous-figure texts; not read here

comparison asked for in NOTES: Brice Dudout's no. 6 reading made before he saw Tomokiyo 2019 (render v14, 22 Oct 2026) agrees with Tomokiyo's appendix reading on 0.975 of letters at aligned places; after 27 transcription corrections taken from Tomokiyo (0/6 confusions) and his values 97 = s, 61 = b, 0.981 (v16). No. 8: same consonant table, vowels the same except 71. Tomokiyo 2019 has priority for segmentation, alphabet and the first reading of both; Brice adds nomenclator values (426 Navarra, 017/617 Infanta, 002 S.S., 007 Spagna) and a translation
